name: anikit-film
description: ANIKIT — a 60 s film (music included) composed in code and rendered by anikit in Node.

scripts.render: npm run soundtrack && node ../packages/anikit/bin/anikit-render.mjs film.mjs --out anikit-film.mp4 --audio soundtrack.wav --workers 3 --fade-in 0.25 --fade-out 0.9 --fade-color 0xece6da
